id./param/scenario/cs/a_170_cs_130.pack|cs_: "Ah, excellent! You came. Let me present to you the Blue Orb of Sniflheim. If you will just come a little closer...
"...Please, stop!
"It's the book! The voice is coming from the book!
"It's the book! The voice is coming from the book!
"Please, you have to listen to me! I am the real Frysabel! The woman in front of you is the witch!
"What!? Ridiculous! She's the witch, not me! Don't believe her lies!
"Hmph! Trick us once, shame on you. Trick us twice, shame on us! You'll just have to get used to being in there!
"No, you're wrong! The spell didn't work because Snorri paused in the middle of it! You have to believe me!
"She's lying! The wicked witch is trying to trick you again! You have to believe me!
"Everybody, calm down! I have been Her Majesty's tutor for ten years. I can tell the real Queen from the impostor.
"I will ask one question of both of you. Whoever answers correctly is the real Queen Frysabel!
"Here is the question: what is the true treasure of Sniflheim? The real Frysabel would remember her father's teachings!
"Tee hee! That's easy! The true treasure of Sniflheim is clearly the Blue Orb! What else is so valuable?
"Hmm... The Orb, you say? Very well, very well...
"Now then, what is your answer?
"The true treasure of Sniflheim is its people. Though blizzards assail them, they warm these climes with ardent hearts.
"Precisely! The very words the royal family has passed down through generations! The real Queen is the one in the book!
"No... She's a liar, you fools! Can't you see! Curse you!
"Oh yes, very queenly!
Veronica snatched the scarf from Frysabel's neck!
...And what's this? A bandage was wrapped around her neck!
"Fine! You caught me out again! I surrender, I surrender.
"I waited ages to get my powers back, and wasted every drop escaping that book! My magic is spent. My life is yours!
"Men! Take her to the dungeon!
"Wait!
"Your Majesty! What are you doing!?
